title: IHG Hotels & Resorts expands partnership with Urban Property Group through two landmark NSW signings
summary: IHG Hotels & Resorts expands its partnership with Urban Property Group with Hotel Indigo Gosford and Crowne Plaza Newcastle in New South Wales.
body_markdown:
[News releases](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases)


16 September 2026


# IHG Hotels & Resorts expands partnership with Urban Property Group through two landmark NSW signings


Hotel Indigo Gosford and Crowne Plaza Newcastle grow partnership to three hotels across New South Wales


Architectural renderings of Crowne Plaza Newcastle and Hotel Indigo Gosford,
two new IHG hotels in New South Wales.[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/hotel-indigo-gosford.jpg)


**Wednesday 16th September, Sydney, Australia:** IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG), one of the world’s leading hotel companies, has expanded its strategic partnership with Urban Property Group (Urban) with the announcement of **Crowne Plaza Newcastle** and **Hotel Indigo Gosford** , growing the relationship to three hotels across New South Wales.


Building on **Crowne Plaza Parramatta** , signed in 2025, the agreement marks the next stage of a growing strategic relationship between IHG and Urban, spanning metropolitan and regional NSW and supporting IHG’s continued portfolio growth across the state.


The two hotels will anchor major mixed-use developments in Gosford and Newcastle, with Hotel Indigo introducing a distinctive lifestyle offering to the Central Coast and Crowne Plaza returning IHG to Newcastle with a significant premium hotel and meetings and events proposition.


**Matt Tripolone, Managing Director, Australasia & Pacific, IHG Hotels & Resorts, said:** “IHG has now signed three exciting new projects with Urban Property Group over the last 12 months, illustrating our shared strategic vision for the sector and the growing strength in our partnership. Urban has a significant development pipeline across New South Wales, and we see considerable opportunity to grow together over the long term.
“Regional growth is an important part of our strategy in Australia, particularly in markets benefiting from sustained investment in infrastructure, tourism and major development. Newcastle and the Central Coast are both significant visitor and economic centres, and we see strong long-term potential for high-quality internationally branded hotels in these locations.
“Crowne Plaza Newcastle and Hotel Indigo Gosford are outstanding additions to our portfolio and very well suited to their respective markets. We are excited to return Crowne Plaza to Newcastle and to bring Hotel Indigo’s distinctive neighbourhood-led experience to the Central Coast for the first time.”


**Patrick Elias, Co-CEO, Urban Property Group, said:** “Our partnership with IHG has grown quickly since signing Crowne Plaza Parramatta last year, and these two new hotels represent an exciting next step.
“As Urban continues to evolve, hospitality is a natural extension of our residential, retail and commercial business, helping us create complete destinations and experiences. By integrating internationally recognised hotel brands into our major precincts, we are creating places that people can live, work, stay and connect, while supporting the long-term growth of these regions. We look forward to growing this partnership and delivering more opportunities together in the future.”


**Crowne Plaza Newcastle** , expected to open in late 2029, will form part of Urban’s landmark mixed-use development adjacent to Newcastle Interchange. The 171-room hotel will sit within the 43-storey development alongside 219 residential apartments and feature all-day dining, a lobby bar, more than 550sqm of Meetings & Events space, including a 425sqm ballroom, a pool and landscaped public spaces.


Newcastle is undergoing significant transformation, supported by major infrastructure investment, population growth and an expanding business, events and visitor economy. The new Crowne Plaza will add a significant premium accommodation and meetings offering to the city as demand continues to grow across the broader Hunter region.


**Hotel Indigo Gosford,** expected to open in mid-2030, will form part of Urban’s *The Waterfront* precinct. The 152-room hotel will feature views across Brisbane Water, a neighbourhood café and bar, rooftop pool and premium wellness facilities, with its design and guest experience drawing inspiration from the stories and character of the local neighbourhood.


The Central Coast is one of New South Wales’ major regional visitor destinations, with continued investment in Gosford’s CBD and waterfront supporting the city’s evolution as a commercial, residential and visitor hub. Hotel Indigo Gosford will bring a new internationally branded lifestyle offering to the market and support the region’s growing overnight visitor economy.

## About URBAN


[https://urbanpropertygroup.com.au/](https://urbanpropertygroup.com.au/)


We’re URBAN. By name, and by nature. A family-owned developer and builder, born and based in Sydney. For nearly 40 years we’ve been building across New South Wales. Homes made to last, in neighbourhoods people want to live in.


We’re the first Australian developer to back every home with 10-year Latent Defects Insurance. We’re also rated 4.5 stars by the NSW Government’s iCIRT scheme. That’s a guarantee you can hold us to. Not a line in a brochure.


Good design shouldn’t be a luxury item. A first home. A growing family’s next step. Or simply a place to belong.


No shortcuts. No compromises. Just great places made to matter.


____________________________________________________________________


Right now, we’ve got more than 10,500 homes on the go across New South Wales. That includes 1,200 affordable housing homes, with developments spanning from Wickham in Newcastle, through Greater Sydney, and down to Wollongong.


In 2026 we’ll have 3,547 homes under construction. Here’s where they are:


- 2 Fitzwilliam St, Parramatta: 703 apartments and a 217-key hotel. In planning.
- The Waterfront, Gosford: A mixed-use precinct. 134 apartments are done. A further 233 apartments, a 150-key hotel and retail are in planning.
- Edmondson Park: 1,900 homes across townhouses, terraces and apartments. Construction’s underway, with more sites moving through planning.
- Mayfair, Penrith: 431 apartments across two towers, including 135 affordable homes and 24 NDIS apartments. Plus ground-floor retail: F&B, convenience and a gym.
- Wickham, Newcastle: 300+ homes planned, alongside a hotel and retail.
- Wollongong: 900+ homes coming at 120-122 Smith Street and Flinders Street.
- Este at Little Bay: A coastal community, under construction now.
- La Vera at Macquarie Park: A premium community beside Lane Cove National Park. Due to complete in September.
- Granville: A mixed-tenure development, construction underway.
- Castle Hill: 371 apartments, designed for real community. In planning.
- Concord West: 1,222 apartments across six buildings on the Parramatta Road corridor. In planning.
- Bella Vista: 717 apartments plus 8,000sqm of retail and commercial space. In planning.


That’s what Genuinely URBAN means: real homes, in real neighbourhoods, built for the people who’ll actually live in them. Come take a look.
